jobs.occupation: Exterior Engineer – Superyachts | Relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands
jobs.description: Are you an Exterior Engineer, CAD Engineer or Product Design Engineer based in Portugal and ready to work on unique, high-end technical projects? Xelvin is looking for an engineer who wants to relocate to the Netherlands and contribute to the exterior design and engineering of luxury superyachts. In this role, you will translate design ideas and customer requirements into smart, manufacturable and high-quality technical solutions. You will work on exterior elements such as railings, sliding door systems, sunshade systems, masts, decorative elements, exterior panels and other visible parts of the yacht. This role combines technical engineering, design sensitivity and practical manufacturability. The exterior of a superyacht must not only function perfectly, but also look flawless. What you will do As an Exterior Engineer, you will be part of a multidisciplinary engineering team. You will work closely with project engineers, architects, production teams and external partners. Your responsibilities include: Creating and developing 3D models for exterior yacht components. Translating design concepts into practical and manufacturable solutions. Engineering exterior parts such as railings, doors, sunshade systems, panels, masts and decorative elements. Checking technical feasibility, quality, cost efficiency and production requirements. Working with other disciplines to make sure exterior systems fit with the overall yacht design. Supporting production and suppliers with clear technical information. Identifying technical risks and proposing smart improvements. Contributing ideas to improve quality, efficiency and manufacturability. Monitoring the technical consistency of your scope within the project. You will work on custom-built projects where every detail must match the overall design and quality standard. What Xelvin offers you A full-time job with long-term perspective in the Netherlands. A gross monthly salary between €3,700 and €5,500, depending on experience.Relocation support from Portugal to the Netherlands. Help with documentation, registration and practical relocation matters. Guidance from our housing consultant. Paid holidays and holiday allowance. Pension arrangement. Training and development opportunities. Personal guidance from Xelvin during the full relocation process. What you bring For the Portuguese market, we are looking for engineers with experience in product design, industrial design, shipbuilding, metalwork, exterior systems or high-end technical engineering. You have: A technical education such as Curso Técnico Superior Profissional, Licenciatura, Mestrado or comparable experience. A background in Industrial Design, Mechanical Engineering, Product Design, Naval Architecture, Shipbuilding, Furniture/Interior Technology or a related technical field. At least 3 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: industrial product design; shipbuilding or marine engineering; yacht interiors or yacht exteriors; metal structures, aluminium or stainless steel components; high-end custom engineering. Strong experience with 2D and 3D CAD software. Experience with SolidWorks, Rhino, AutoCAD, Inventor, Siemens NX, CATIA, Fusion 360 or similar software. Good understanding of manufacturability, materials and technical detailing. A strong eye for shape, finish and visual quality. Good English communication skills. Motivation to relocate from Portugal to the Netherlands. Dutch is not required. Willingness to learn Dutch over time is a plus. Every project is unique and requires close collaboration between design, engineering, production, suppliers and specialist partners. The working environment is technical, international and quality-driven, with a strong focus on craftsmanship, innovation and tailor-made solutions.

Postdoc - Molecular Oncology & Immunology  Function description The Daniel Peeper Group at the Netherlands Cancer Institute is seeking an ambitious postdoctoral researcher with a strong background in immunology and cancer biology to join an exciting international project exploring the "dark peptidome" as a new source of targets for cancer immunotherapy. Cancer immunotherapy has been transformed by checkpoint inhibitors and adoptive cell therapies, but remains limited by the scarcity of validated, tumor-specific antigens. Mutation-derived neoantigens and overexpressed self-proteins are often low in number, weakly immunogenic and carry cross-reactivity risk, leaving patients with a low tumor mutational burden with little benefit. In an international collaboration we are starting a project that instead aims to discover immune reactivity towards the tumor "dark peptidome": cryptic antigens that arise by non-canonical errors. They are presented on MHC molecules, but are absent from normal tissue. Being tumor-restricted and potentially shared between patients, these dark peptides are attractive targets for T cell receptor (TCR)-based therapy. Among several advanced technologies, we will use the heterotypic T cell:tumor cell clusters we recently reported (1). Identified lead TCRs will be engineered and validated in preclinical models. Your profile We seek a highly ambitious postdoc with a strong background in immunology and cancer biology, and an interest in both fundamental and translational cancer research. Experience with corresponding technologies including flow cytometry, cell culture, CRISPR screening, (single-cell) sequencing, and in vivo tumor models is an advantage. Your responsibilities will include writing of manuscripts and grant applications, as well as close interaction with our international partners.
